source_text: Empirical review of major collections like Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim reveals no sahih (authentic) Hadiths explicitly mandating FGM, unlike the robust chains supporting male circumcision as fitrah (innate disposition) in Sahih Muslim 257.
